officialCriteria: A Barrier clarity; B Usefulness; C Creativity/originality; D Pilot feasibility; E Career impact/equity; F Civic relevance; G Scalability/sustainability; H Measurement; I Accessibility/inclusive design; J Presentation/communication
rubric: Each criterion 0–10, summed /100, equal working weights. Official detailed table gives 0–10; general wording says 0–100 and final weighted score without published numeric weights. Do not invent weights. Tie-break E then D.
evidenceBudget: Same 5-minute scripted public journey plus same-length bounded evidence packet per snapshot; each assessor receives both neutral A/B snapshots, neither prior scores nor target. Assessment not a timed human or independent blinded study. Preserve every rating and deduction.
